name: Arab USD
description: Arab USD (AUSD) has a $1 InvestArab accounting price, a $1 external target and a maximum outstanding supply of 10 billion tokens, including treasury holdings. Issuance requires deposited collateral, redeemable 1:1 in that asset. The cap is not circulating supply or funded reserves. External markets may deviate; deployment, reserves and exchange approvals are disclosed separately. The deployed contract redeems for a custom collateral token named USDT. Its dollar value and issuer backing are not attested; it is not canonical BSC USDT. AUSD trades against canonical BSC USDT on PancakeSwap V2 (pair 0x67b79884B5aaD4335013c849799a93feDaed454C); that pool is operator funded and its depth is not a reserve.
